title: Let Their Voices Take Over (Standard)
description: I'm very excited to share with everyone my next collaboration with Monika and Embrr! This is an initiation into a whole new way of thinking. Into My Empire. We will condition you to let us in. Even the simplest suggestion can be so powerful. You will Obey. You'll learn to love it. No matter who it comes from. Obey their will as you would mine. Pray to them as you would to Me. Pray and you shall receive. Pray to us.
author: Mistress Shibby
